noDmxInterface.title: No DMX interface configured
noDmxInterface.description: Scenes that include DMX fixtures need a working output. Open Settings → DMX, enable USB DMX and/or Art-Net, then select a USB device or Art-Net target (or turn on a simulator for testing).

empty.message: No scenes yet. Create one to get started.

editor.partyTargetsHint: Choose which WLED devices and DMX fixtures participate when you start party mode from this scene. Only one scene can be the party scene at a time.
editor.sceneCuesHint: Scenes use each fixture's Scene cues (not Party cues). Add them on the fixture page under Scene cues.

replaceDefault.bodyGeneric: Only one scene can be the startup default. Another scene is already marked as default. Continue?

replaceParty.bodyWithCurrent: Only one scene can be the party scene. “{{name}}” is currently the party scene. Make this scene the new party scene instead?
